_provenance: SYNTHETIC. Every row is invented to exercise a rendering shape the pane has to get right — a long body, an empty body, a long title, a thread, an epic and a closed ask that must not appear, an archived insight, and an enacted insight (ex-0011 carries `enacted:law-closed-is-not-landed`). It is deliberately NOT a dump of a real database: a beads database holds internal working notes and agent memories and is never public, so a fixture cut from one cannot ship with the harness.
_usage: PANEL_FIXTURE=tests/fixture.json ./target/release/panel --once --size 107x19 [--sel N]. Review screenshots are regenerated on demand with ./capture.sh and are not committed.
_note: The escalation label here is the shipped default. Against an installation that configured SPIRA_ASK_LABEL to something else, run the panel with that value set. Alert rows (ex-01xx) cover the four states the ALERTS tab must tell apart: firing-and-unseen, acknowledged, flapping, and cleared.

beads.title: Raise the connection-pool ceiling, or add a second box?
beads.description:
**Default — what I would do:** raise the pool ceiling to 32 and leave the queue depth alarm where it is.

**What is blocked:** nothing yet. The service is serving; this decides whether the next traffic step needs a second box or fits on this one.

**Evidence**
```
  pool          16 connections, 100% utilised for 41 of the last 60 minutes
  queue depth   p50 0, p99 214, max 1,102
  latency       p50 4ms, p99 890ms  <- entirely queue wait, not work
```

Doubling the pool costs memory and nothing else, and it is one config line to put back. A second box is a week and cannot be undone in an afternoon.

_Answer inline in the cockpit pane, or:_
`cockpit/ask.sh answered <id> "<verdict>"`

beads.title: Rotate the signing key now or at the next release?
beads.description:
**Default — what I would do:** rotate at the next release; nothing is exposed.

**What is blocked:** nothing. The current key is valid for 60 more days.

Reversing an early rotation means re-signing every artifact already published.

beads.title: The nightly reconciliation job has been reporting success while writing nothing, and the check that would have caught it reads the same field the job writes
beads.description: **Default:** measure the row count, not the exit status.

beads.title: Should the retry budget be per-call or per-request?
A green check is not evidence the thing works
beads.description: Eleven of fourteen defects one week were in the checking machinery rather than the work. Before believing a green signal, ask what it would look like if the check itself were broken.

beads.title: grep -q under pipefail inverts the test
beads.description: grep -q exits at the first match, the writer takes SIGPIPE, and pipefail propagates 141 — so the test fails precisely when it succeeds.
